name: MINERvA
summary: MINERvA measured neutrino and antineutrino interactions on several nuclear targets in the NuMI beam, separating nuclear effects from the underlying neutrino scattering process.
physics_targets: Exclusive and inclusive neutrino-nucleus cross sections
Nuclear effects, multinucleon processes and final-state interactions
detection_principle: Fine plastic-scintillator tracking measures outgoing charged particles, surrounded by electromagnetic and hadronic sampling calorimeters. Upstream carbon, iron and lead targets and other target configurations permit controlled comparisons; MINOS supplies downstream muon measurements.
